title: Add a connection: business database
readOnlyBody: Create a dedicated database user that can only SELECT from the tables you want to share. NIVO only reads, but a read-only user keeps it that way whatever happens.
fieldHostHint: A public host name or IP address. Servers on a private network cannot be reached.
passwordSaved: A password is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
tablesHint: Pick the tables to bring in. For each one choose what the rows are, the column that identifies a row, and the columns to bring (at most {max}).
colIdHint: Unique per row, so a re-sync updates the same row.
colUpdatedHint: Optional. With it, each sync reads only rows changed since the last one.
colCap: Only the first {max} columns are brought.
limitNote: Each sync reads up to {rows} rows per table.
scheduleHint: NIVO reads the database on this schedule. You can also sync by hand from the connection list.
agentTitle: Which agents may read this data
